dates.quote: Self-financed Applicants: December 1st, 2026-May 30th, 2027The academic term begins each year in September (the exact date will be specified in the Admission Letter).

costs.quote: Program Duration: 4 years.Tuition: RMB 20000.00 per year.Application Fee: RMB 400.00Note: All applicants are required to pay a non-refundable and non-transferable application fee of RMB 400.00 (approximately USD 60.00).

eligibility.quote: Applicants must be high school graduates, between 18 and 25 years of age, and in good health.·Former Chinese citizens who have emigrated and are applying as international students must hold a valid foreign passport or nationality certificate for at least four years. In addition, they must provide proof of having lived abroad for a minimum of two years.

materials.quote: Application DocumentsNote: Only electronic application materials need to be uploaded to the application system at the time of application. If admitted, you must bring the original paper versions of all application materials for verification when you register on campus. Failure to provide the originals, or any inconsistency between the originals and the submitted electronic materials, will result in disqualification from enrollment.1. Application FormPlease apply via http://gjy.shmtu.edu.cn/login.2. Self-introduction VideoThis video should not exceed 5 minutes, and contents should cover your personality, hobbies, high school performance and awards. If you apply for a Chinese-taught program, the video should be made in Chinese. If you apply for an English-taught program, the video should be made in English.3. High School Diploma or Official Proof of Expected GraduationThe diploma/proof must be in Chinese or English, with the official school stamp or by the embassy’ notarization.4. TranscriptsTranscripts must be in Chinese or English, with the official school stamp or by the embassy’s notarization.5. Language Credentials·For Chinese-taught programs: HSK Level 5 certificate. Exemption from Chinese Proficiency Certificate: (1) Native Chinese speakers; (2) Applicants whose previous high school program was taught in Chinese.·For English-taught programs: IELTS 6.0/ TOEFL 80/ Cambridge English B2 (or above) certificate dated within the recent two years. Exemption from English Proficiency Certificate: (1) Native English speakers; (2) Applicants whose high school program was taught in English; (3)Applicants who can provide other equivalent English proficiency certificates. The certificates must be reviewed and approved by SMU.6. Transcript of the Chinese Study Competence Assessment (CSCA) for Undergraduate Admission to China·Applicants for Chinese-taught programs:The Chinese Liberal Arts or Chinese Science test is required, as well as Mathematics. For other required subjects, please refer to the 2027 Undergraduate Program List or the CSCA Test Subject List. All test subjects must be taken using the Chinese test papers.·Applicants for English-taught programs:Only Mathematics test is required, and it must be taken using the English test paper.·Visit https://csca.cn/home to check exam schedules, register online, take the exam, and view your results (released within 1–2 weeks after the exam).7. Study StatementThe statement should not be less than 800 words. The contents should cover study and work experience, academic qualification, research plan, and career goal after graduation.8. Copy of Passport Bio-data PageApplicants must submit a clear scanned copy of their passport bio-data page containing (name, date of birth, passport number, expiration date, place of issue, passport type information, and photo). If the validity of the passport is less than 10 months (calculated from January 2027), please renew the passport.9. Medical Examination Report Medical Examination Report.pdf The physical examinations must cover all the items listed in the Foreigner Physical Examination Form. Incomplete records or any medical form without the signature of the attending physician, official stamp of the hospital, or a sealed photograph of the applicants are invalid. Please select the appropriate time to take a physical examination as the result is valid for only 6 months. 10. Certificate of Non-Criminal ConvictionThe applicant shall submit a valid certificate of Non-Criminal Record issued by the local public security authority, usually issued within 6 months prior to the submission date of the application. 11. Statement of Financial Support Statement of Financial Support.docx12. Receipt of Application feePlease see HOW TO PAY for the transferApplicants who fail to pay their application fee will not be reviewed.Application Procedure·Self-financied Programs1. Self-financed applicants need to apply via http://gjy.shmtu.edu.cn/login.2. After completing the online application, applicants must download an sign the application form.3. All documents will be reviewed by SMU.4. Applicants who pass the document review will receive a notice of preliminary interview.5. Applicants who passed the preliminary interview will then be interviewed by the respective college they applied.6. Applicants who pass the college interview will receive an admission letter.
